document.title: R. STAHL SolConeX Wall-Mounted Socket, 16 A, Series 8570/11
document.pages: English pp.6-9 technical data and 8570/11-4.. contacts; pp.11-13 installation and operation (PDF24-27,29-31)

modelingNotes: Exact unsuffixed 8570/11-407, article 150554: 16 A, 480-500 V AC, 50-60 Hz, 4 contacts (3P+PE), black, 7h. Manufacturer selection: Wall-Mounting Sockets, Series 8570/11 SolConeX 16 A, 24.03.2019 PO en, PDF2: https://www.rstahl.hu/uploads/8570-11-adatlap.pdf. Terminal capability 500 V is the range upper bound, not an authored supply voltage. Installed hardware revision is unverified; newer replacements are not implied.

Manual PDF26 diagram 06556E00 identifies L1, L2, L3 and the protective-earth symbol for 8570/11-4.., viewed from the front at 6h. PDF27 specifies 7h for the 480-500 V variant. No rotation, exact 7h pin coordinates, rear-view layout, numerical pin mapping or installed phase assignment is inferred.

C.L1/C.L2/C.L3/C.PE are functional cable-side pole endpoints; C is not a manufacturer marking and actual cable-clamp legends and individual screw positions are unverified. M.L1/M.L2/M.L3/M.PE expose the corresponding mating-contact identities. PE is a textual alias for the earth symbol. C/M distinguish sides and are not stamped terminal numbers.

The base catalog row has no auxiliary contacts. The 8570/11-407-S001 accessory-equipped variant and 8570/11-407-S020 are different selections. Optional auxiliary accessory seats are not fitted electrical terminals in this type. No neutral, shield, signal, communication or additional bond screw is verified.

Three main poles are interlocked and ganged; open is the OFF reference position, not a simulated state. Never permanently jumper C.L1-M.L1, C.L2-M.L2 or C.L3-M.L3. Only explicit wires, jumpers and terminated cable cores join nets; function and connector-port metadata do not conduct.

Always connect cable-side PE. Author the fixed internal C.PE-M.PE conductor as an explicit project jumper. The shared connection policy permits that internal representation plus an external lead; it does not approve multiple field conductors under a clamp. A presence check can pass with only an internal PE jumper and cannot prove an external protective-earth supply.

The 2019 catalog PDF3 gives -30 to +40 degrees C for the unsuffixed base, while the 2014 manual gives a broader family temperature range. No automatic temperature, ingress, Ex approval, motor-load or protection-coordination verdict is encoded. IP66 depends on the applicable complete assembly; review the installed nameplate, seals, entries, protection and manual revision.

The 2014 manual PDF31 restricts use to the stated R. STAHL plug families and operation with a plug inserted. This type does not assert compatibility with every family member or a modern successor; verify exact poles, voltage, clock code, approvals and hardware revision separately.

connectionCoverage.notes: Four cable-side pole endpoints and four mating contacts are inventoried, with three switched poles and PE. The four-contact manufacturer drawing identifies L1/L2/L3/earth but is a 6h front view: exact 7h orientation, physical cable-clamp markings and individual screw/bond positions remain unverified. No optional accessories are fitted. C/M and textual PE are authoring aliases; fixed PE needs an explicit project jumper.
